answer: Continuous Provenance Ledger. Each agent must anchor every action to a hash of its prior action, forming an unbroken chain validated by peers. A sudden burst of parallel chains from one source emits a divergence signal that audit nodes flag for review. Reputation accrues only to chains surviving a periodic random gale of adversarial replay, wiping unverified clones. An attacker pays continuous compute and latency to sustain each fake history, and a single break resets it to zero.
